name: Length Converter
description: Convert length between millimeters, centimeters, meters, kilometers, inches, feet, yards, and miles instantly.

faq.question: How accurate are these conversions?
faq.answer: Every unit is defined by its exact SI conversion factor (e.g. 1 inch = 0.0254 meters exactly), so results are as accurate as floating-point arithmetic allows — displayed rounded to a readable number of decimal places.

faq.question: Can I convert between any two units, not just to meters?
faq.answer: Yes — pick any "From" and "To" unit; the conversion goes through meters internally but you never see that step. The table below also shows your value converted into every supported unit at once.

faq.question: Is this calculation done on a server?
faq.answer: No — it's plain JavaScript arithmetic that runs instantly in your browser. Nothing is sent anywhere.
